project_info.theme: Shopee VIP first birthday livestream event poster

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Shopee VIP first birthday livestream event poster. Centerpiece is a celebrity-style cast poster featuring host Ngọc Phước and six UPRIZE performers in front of a red stage-curtain backdrop, with a giant golden '1 TUỔI' anniversary mark. Background is a festive stage scene with confetti, spotlights, and cartoon birthday props. Surrounding elements: Shopee and Shopee VIP logos, exact headline 'ĐẠI TIỆC SINH NHẬT Shopee VIP 1 TUỔI', cast name tags, offer boxes 'DEAL ĐỘC QUYỀN', 'VOUCHER 30%', '10 CƠ HỘI DÙNG SHOPEEVIP MIỄN PHÍ 1 NĂM', and footer 'XEM LÚC 11H / NGÀY 20.6 / TRÊN Shopee LIVE'. Technical style: photorealistic entertainment poster compositing, stage event lighting, warm spotlights and confetti sparkle, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
